title: Liquid Sand Hot Tub- Fluidized air bed
summary: Mark Rober builds a hot tub filled with sand fluidized by air blown from below, so that the sand behaves like a liquid. He explains how fluidized beds work and shows people swimming in them.
why: HN mentions it as the famous, kid-delighting demo of fluidization, especially in sand battery and industrial process threads.

quote.text: See this fun fluidized sand-filled jacuzzi
